name: KGRequirements
title: Knowledge graph L3: Requirements
description: A FHIR Requirements resource. The ONE place the published SOP names an SG profile -- SGRequirements -- and the grain is one resource per business process holding many statements, not one per requirement. ZERO in the immunizations IG and 41 in smart-base. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/requirements.

element.definition: A FHIR Requirements resource. The ONE place the published SOP names an SG profile -- SGRequirements -- and the grain is one resource per business process holding many statements, not one per requirement. ZERO in the immunizations IG and 41 in smart-base. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/requirements.
The canonical URL. Only a resolved component carries one.
The FHIR resource type.
A profile canonical the artefact declares (meta.profile or the requirement's profile).
The resource's status (FHIR PublicationStatus).
The business version, as declared.
The human-readable title.
The computable name: the CamelCase identifier a Canonical() reference matches on.
The publisher, as declared.
The resource's experimental flag.
How many statements the Requirements resource holds.
Where the node was read from: a repository path or URL.
Hash of the file the node was read from; pins the source.
